entries.name: Cleave
entries.description: On a melee hit, you can attack a second creature within 5 feet of the first and within your reach. On a hit it takes the weapon's damage without your ability modifier (unless negative). Once per turn.

entries.name: Graze
entries.description: If you miss, the target takes damage equal to the ability modifier you used for the attack, of the weapon's damage type.

entries.name: Nick
entries.description: The extra attack of the Light property can be made as part of the Attack action instead of as a Bonus Action. Once per turn.

entries.name: Push
entries.description: On a hit against a Large or smaller creature, you can push it up to 10 feet straight away from you.

entries.name: Sap
entries.description: On a hit, the target has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Slow
entries.description: On a hit that deals damage, the target's Speed drops by 10 feet until the start of your next turn (the reduction never exceeds 10 feet).

entries.name: Topple
entries.description: On a hit, the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 + the attack's ability modifier + your Proficiency Bonus) or have the Prone condition.

entries.name: Vex
entries.description: On a hit that deals damage, you have Advantage on your next attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn.
